### Unprofitable Works
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/unprofitable-works
Passage: Titus 3:9
Points:
- Paul commands believers to steer clear of useless controversies and quarrels about the law.
- Sound doctrine is intended to produce visible good deeds and loving service to others.
- False teachers often major on minor matters and speculative theories rather than godliness.
- Christians should stand firmly for the truth without becoming eager to pick fights.
- Believers must discern which topics truly foster spiritual growth and ignore unprofitable arguments.

### The Heart of the Debate
Author: Katherine Britton
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/crosswalk-the-devotional-sept-23-2009-11608834.html
Passage: Titus 3:9
Points:
- Healthy biblical discussions can easily degenerate into arguing merely for the sake of winning.
- Speculative and unhelpful debates distract believers from what truly matters in their walk of faith.
- Serving together alongside fellow Christians is far more fruitful than endless theological sparring.
- Obsessing over minor details risks pushing the core truth of the gospel aside.
- Arguing over peripheral issues can become an idol that damages Christian fellowship.
